summary: IDS feed c060_nic_crc is degraded: NPB-01 port 3 is delivering 15,780 CRC-damaged frames (0.307% error rate) and IDS eth1 is discarding 1.97% (101,100 packets) due to capture overload, both causing incomplete traffic for IDS detection.

findings.root_cause: NPB-01 port 3 (input) is receiving damaged frames with CRC/alignment errors at 0.307% (15,780 frames, 307x threshold of 0.001%), indicating a physical layer fault on the link into the packet broker such as faulty cable/optic, dirty connector, or duplex mismatch.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS receives corrupted frames that fail FCS validation and are dropped before analysis, creating blind spots and wasted processing; IDS with needs_full_payload=true cannot inspect damaged payloads, reducing detection coverage.

recommended_fix.why: Physical errors must be fixed at source - no broker feature can repair CRC errors. Clean/reseat/replace cable and optic, verify speed/duplex on both ends, and re-check error counters.

findings.root_cause: IDS eth1 capture interface is oversubscribed and discarding 101,100 packets (1.97% loss, 19x threshold of 0.1%) because offered traffic exceeds the 1 Gbps tool's capture/processing capacity.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS loses ~2% of packets after delivery, causing incomplete flows, missed signatures, and evasion risk; with needs_both_directions and needs_full_payload, any loss breaks stateful detection and file extraction.

recommended_fix.why: Tool NIC/host cannot keep up with load. Increase capture capacity via host tuning (RSS, buffers, driver), upgrade NIC/link speed, or load_balance/filter traffic across multiple IDS instances to fit 1G capacity.
